entries.en: D'ya know why they had to make him CEO?
entries.ro: Știi de ce a trebuit să-l facă CEO?

entries.en: 'Cause buyin' 'im from Militech was so expensive – now they're embarrassed…
entries.ro: Păi, l-au luat de la Militech și le-a ieșit scump – acum le e rușine…
Pentru că nu valorează un căcat!

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="飲み過ぎよ、チューマ… 本当はそんなこと思ってないでしょ…" t="C'mon, choom, you're wasted – you don't really think that..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="飲み過ぎよ、チューマ… 本当はそんなこと思ってないでしょ…" t="Hai, choom, ești beat – nu crezi chiar asta..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Lemme tell you somethin' – there ain't nothin' worse than a gonk boss.
entries.ro: Să-ți zic ceva – nu e nimic mai nasol decât un șef fraier.

entries.en: Oh man, you gonna regret sayin' this tomorrow morning.
entries.ro: Frate, mâine dimineață o să regreți ce-ai zis.

entries.en: I don't regret shit. If he was here, I'd tell him to his fuckin' face!
entries.ro: Nu regret nimic. Dacă ar fi aici, i-aș zice-n față, pula mea!

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ええ、これで十分。有意義な夜だったわね" t="Yeah, we can go. This was a very productive evening." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ええ、これで十分。有意義な夜だったわね" t="Da, putem pleca. A fost o seară foarte productivă." b="" a=""/>
